name: SmartProductSEO Product Notes Pad
author: jolizzie

sections.description:
SmartProductSEO Product Notes Pad is a lightweight notes tool for WooCommerce administrators.

Features include:

  • Product-specific notes on WooCommerce product edit screens.
  • A reusable global note available across product edit screens.
  • Automatic note saving while you type.
  • Manual Save buttons.
  • Copy note text to the clipboard.
  • Download a note as a PNG screenshot.
  • Enable or disable product notes, global notes, and screenshots.
  • Choose the floating Notes button position.

No customer-facing scripts or styles are loaded on the public storefront. Plugin assets load only on the plugin admin page and WooCommerce product edit screens.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate SmartProductSEO Product Notes Pad.
  3. Open Product Notes Pad in the WordPress admin menu to configure settings or edit a WooCommerce product and click Notes.
sections.faq:
Does this modify product content?

No. Product notes are stored separately as product metadata and are not added to the public product description.

Where is the global note stored?

The global note is stored in the WordPress options table and is available to authorized administrators and product editors in the admin area.

Does the plugin contact an external service?

No. Notes and plugin settings are handled within your WordPress installation.

Does it load on the storefront?

No. The plugin interface assets are limited to the WordPress admin screens where the notes tools are used.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added WordPress.org screenshot descriptions for the Product Notes Pad dashboard, Saved Product Notes dashboard, and floating WooCommerce product editor notes pad.

1.0.9

  • Added drag-to-move support to the floating Product Notes Pad. Drag the header to reposition the pad when it covers product content.

1.0.8

  • Fixed the floating Product Notes Pad so it ends immediately below the footer tagline instead of leaving decorative overflow space beneath it.

1.0.7

  • Fixed excess bottom spacing in the floating Product Notes Pad.

1.0.6

  • Tightened the floating Product Notes Pad so it sizes to its content instead of leaving excess empty space at the bottom.
  • Reduced unnecessary vertical spacing while preserving the neon v1.0.5 design and all note actions.

1.0.5

  • Redesigned the floating product edit-page notes pad to match the neon black and bright-pink dashboard.
  • Added Product Note / Global Note tabs, live word and character counts, stronger action buttons, animated glow effects, and an updated footer.
  • Uses native text emoji only; no remote icon or image assets were added.

1.0.4

  • Redesigned the admin dashboard with a black and neon bright-pink workspace.
  • Added lightweight glow, shimmer, pulse, and floating animations with reduced-motion support.
  • Added native text emoji accents that do not rely on remote image links.
  • Added product thumbnail previews to saved note cards when a featured image is available.
  • Restyled notes, settings, filters, counters, buttons, and saved-note cards for a more engaging workflow.

1.0.3

  • Added real Saved Product Notes overview counters.
  • Added instant search by product name or note text.
  • Added To Do, In Progress, and Done note statuses with filtering.
  • Added pinning so important notes stay at the top.
  • Added sorting by recent update, oldest update, and product name.
  • Added live word and character counts.
  • Added Last Updated tracking.
  • Added Copy Note and dashboard-only Delete controls.
  • Added collapsible saved-note cards.

1.0.2

  • Added editable saved product notes on the plugin dashboard.
  • Added a Save Note button to each saved product note.
  • Added a Download Screenshot button to each saved product note.
  • Dashboard edits stay synchronized with the product edit-page note.

1.0.1

  • Added a Saved Product Notes section to the plugin dashboard.
  • Added a Save to Dashboard button to the floating product notes pad.
  • Saving the same product again updates its dashboard note instead of creating duplicates.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of SmartProductSEO Product Notes Pad.
  • Product-specific notes and global notes for WooCommerce product editing.
  • Auto-save, manual save, copy, screenshot download, and basic settings.
